caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with four tall, turned bedposts at each corner, each post tapering to a point at the top. The cradle stands on two curved rockers that allow it to rock back and forth. The sides of the cradle are made of a series of vertical wooden spindles connecting the top and bottom horizontal rails, and the shorter ends also have similar spindle designs. Inside the cradle, there is a cushioned mattress or bedding featuring a muted, multicolored pattern with shades of green, blue, and beige. The entire cradle is rendered in tonal shades of brown to represent the wooden material, and the background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or decorations present. The artist's signature, "Pearl Davis," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Cradle
